messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add a mechanic to the existing playable game where monsters dodge when the player spams attacks.

## Requirements
- Build the change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- When finished, briefly note assumptions.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The repository already contains a browser RPG, ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire; apply the mechanic to its existing combat system.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game structure and combat implementation.

### Active
- Implement monster dodging in response to repeated player attacks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a spam-tracking and dodge response to `attack()` in `game.js`, with clear player feedback and suitable tuning.
2. Check that normal attacks, Arcane Burst, enemy animations, and combat progression still work.
3. Run the game and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report the change and any brief assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing attack, enemy state, combat log, and canvas rendering logic.
- `index.html`: Combat controls and encounter UI.
- `style.css`: Existing game presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- `attack()` currently applies damage immediately; normal attacks have a 0.55-second cooldown, while Arcane Burst costs 12 mana and has a 1.5-second cooldown.
- Enemy state is initialized in `spawnEnemy()`; the animation loop and enemy drawing are in `tick()` and `drawEnemy()`.
- No files have been changed yet.
